programme.title: Love Express

programme.title: Golmaal

programme.title: Highway

programme.desc: Logan, a former mutant mercenary, lives a peaceful life, void of violence, with his girlfriend Kayla. But, when Kayla is brutally murdered by someone from his past, he decides to seek vengeance.

programme.title: Eternals
programme.desc: The Eternals, a race of immortal beings who possess superpowers, secretly live on Earth for thousands of years. However, they must answer evil's call and reunite to defeat the powerful Deviants.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The Fire Nation wreaks havoc on the peaceful coexistence of Air, Water, Earth and Fire nations. A young successor Aang must master all four elements to bring an end to decades of destruction.

programme.title: Dora and the Lost City of Gold
programme.desc: While searching for a hidden land, the parents of a teenage Dora go missing. Consequently, she and her new high-school friends go in search of the lost city of gold with hopes of finding her parents.

programme.title: Life of Pi
programme.desc: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat together where they must learn to trust each other to survive.

programme.title: Journey to the West: The Demons Strike Back
programme.desc: Tang Sanzang, a monk and his three disciples strive to overcome multiple challenges and fight monsters during the course of their journey.

programme.title: Baby's Day Out

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Chaos erupt and multiple lives are endangered when the RMS Titanic, a supposedly unsinkable ship, crashes against an iceberg in the Atlantic Ocean.

programme.title: Antriksha Ka Aakraman

programme.title: Cosmoball

programme.title: Mojin The Treasure Valley

programme.title: Avatar

programme.desc: The Avengers and their allies set out to stop Thanos, an alien warlord, from acquiring the Infinity Stones as he plans to eliminate half of all life from the universe using them.
